name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-vscode
description: VSCode extension for the dsh harness: spawns the harness child process, manages the DeepSeek credential, and serves sessions as editor tabs

commands.title: Import DeepSeek API Key from ACP Client Settings

dsh.command.markdownDescription: Command spawned as the harness child: the `dsh` bin on PATH, or an absolute path to a built bin (see `#dsh.node#`).

dsh.profile.markdownDescription: Profile the child boots. `web` ships today; a dedicated `vscode` profile arrives with the IDE-context plugin.

dsh.node.markdownDescription: When set, the child command is launched through this Node executable, e.g. `node` together with an absolute path in `#dsh.command#`. Empty spawns `#dsh.command#` directly. Never point this at the extension host (Electron).

dsh.home.markdownDescription: `DSH_HOME` for the child process (session store, profiles). Empty inherits the child default (`~/.dsh`).

dsh.spawnTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait for the child's ready line before killing it and retrying.

dsh.extraEnv.markdownDescription: Extra environment entries for the child, merged after the credential entry. Use for `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`-style deployment overrides.
